briefing_ko:
- **[DCENT](https://x.com/DCENTWALLETS/status/2100076991798206573)** ( ) — DCENT App Wallet에서 $6.57M 자산이 탈취되었습니다.
- **[Revolut](https://www.blockmedia.co.kr/archives/1140990)** (Monero) — 해커가 고객 데이터 탈취 후 6000 XMR(≈$3M) 몸값을 요구했습니다.
- **[Flamincome](https://x.com/SlowMist_Team/status/2100256590716907706)** (Ethereum) — 플래시 론으로 USDP/3CRV LP를 주입해 VaultYUSDT 가격을 부풀린 뒤 $345.9K를 탈취했습니다.
- **소액** — BonfireSwap $47K, Startale $2.9K.
- **시사점** — 스마트 계약 초기화 플래그·allowance 검증 부재를 이용한 공격이 연속 발생했습니다.
briefing_en:
- **[DCENT](https://x.com/DCENTWALLETS/status/2100076991798206573)** ( ) — $6.57M was stolen from the DCENT App Wallet.
- **[Revolut](https://www.blockmedia.co.kr/archives/1140990)** (Monero) — hackers exfiltrated customer data and demanded 6000 XMR (~$3M) ransom.
- **[Flamincome](https://x.com/SlowMist_Team/status/2100256590716907706)** (Ethereum) — attacker used a flash-loan to inflate VaultYUSDT price and extracted $345.9K.
- **Smaller** — BonfireSwap $47K, Startale $2.9K.
- **Takeaway** — Re-using initialization flags or unchecked allowance checks in smart contracts remains a common exploit vector.
